description:
List/filter items, scoped to the caller's member companies (A1).

Optional ``period`` (``YYYY-MM``) filters by the item's effective date
(invoice date, falling back to the Europe/Zurich-local ingestion date); a
malformed value returns 422 ``{"msg": "period must be YYYY-MM"}``.
``exclude_triage_status`` drops items carrying that triage verdict (NULL-safe;
for ``unrelated`` not a booked one, ZCT-954). Payables/Receivables pass
``unrelated``, so parked items show only in the Inbox.

Optional ``q`` is free text: a case-insensitive **partial (substring)** match
over the filename and the counterparty name from *both* of its sources (the
linked counterparty and the extracted ``data.company``). ``%``/``_`` are
matched literally, blank is ignored, and ``total`` counts the filtered set.

``duplicate`` filters on the row's ``is_duplicate`` flag (ZET-413); ``credit_note`` on
its ``is_credit_note`` flag (ZET-429) — both server-side, so ``total`` stays exact.
``posted`` filters on the posting badge (ZCT-811): ``true`` = posted, ``false`` = held,
reversed or not booked; a copy filed with the booking of the same invoice ("Already
booked", ``posting.filed_with``) is in neither (ZEN-1).

anyOf.description:
Query-filter vocabulary for ``Item.direction`` — NEVER a column type.

``Item.direction`` is tri-state (``payable``/``receivable``/NULL = unknown);
the PG ``direction`` enum stays binary. This enum exists so list endpoints
can accept ``direction=unknown`` (→ ``direction IS NULL``) alongside the two
real values without widening the DB enum.

AI ingest-gate verdict parking an item in the Inbox (pipeline §"Ingest triage",
§"Relevance gate").

NULL = not triaged / normal flow. ``irrelevant``/``needs_review`` are the
metadata-triage verdicts on a held-unusable item (a human override flips
between them; re-analysis resets the columns to NULL). ``unrelated`` is the
relevance-gate verdict on a *cleanly extracted* invoice that doculyse's
entity resolver matched to neither party of the owning company — the item is
held ``pending`` (never archived, no counterparty, never coded) until a human
restores it (clears the verdict) or deletes it.
